profile.title: Metro-Atlanta BHPH dealer
profile.detail: Independent dealer financing its own subprime auto notes in one of the fastest-growing metros in the South.

profile.title: In-house servicing
profile.detail: Payments, collections and repossessions handled by your own back office.

profile.title: Competitive Georgia market
profile.detail: Georgia is a top-3 state by dedicated buyer interest on Debexpert - your paper is in demand.

profile.title: Rate pressure
profile.detail: Elevated floorplan and credit-line rates keep squeezing per-unit margins across the BHPH industry.

challenges.title: Capital tied up in long notes
challenges.detail: Money sits in 30-42 month notes while auction lanes are full of inventory you could be turning.

challenges.title: Charge-off risk is rising
challenges.detail: Subprime auto delinquency remains near record highs nationally - every held vintage carries more risk.

challenges.title: Collections cost keeps climbing
challenges.detail: Skip tracing and repo logistics in a sprawling metro eat into servicing margin.

challenges.title: No market check on direct offers
challenges.detail: One-off offers from local buyers give no way to know the true market price of Georgia BHPH paper.

industryInsights.fact: Subprime auto 60+ day delinquencies remained near record levels through 2025-2026.
Georgia ranks #3 on Debexpert by dedicated state buyer interest.

solutions.title: Cash in ~14 days
solutions.detail: Average auction closes and funds in about two weeks - capital goes back into inventory.

solutions.title: Transfer risk while prices hold
solutions.detail: Sell performing paper before delinquency erodes it; recourse and non-recourse structures available.

solutions.title: Sell the tail, keep the core
solutions.detail: Auction skips, deficiencies and charge-offs so your team only services accounts that pay.

solutions.title: Let the market set the price
solutions.detail: Thousands of registered buyers compete in an open auction - you see every bid.
